claim: Patchline ships a non-inferiority analysis proving low reviewer-time overhead within a margin. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the non-inferiority claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make non-inferiority-analysis-gate`.
